_comment: Real CAD parts used as products (Day 6). Only redistributable licenses. fetch_parts.ps1 downloads status=selected entries (or -Name for any) to raw/<name>.step and records sha256 on first download. status: selected | candidate | rejected (with reason). FreeCAD-library URLs are pinned to commit f5ca01cdcaa2f69b9295a6382719c2d90628780c (2026-10-07). Attribution: LICENSES.md.
